rationale.A: 460 m in mixed traffic on Hermannin rantatie (40 km/h); 5 lights
rationale.B: Path beside Kustaa Vaasan tie (50 km/h) and Hermannin rantatie; 80 m on Intiankatu; 6 lights
rationale.C: A's corridor via Kumpulantaival, on the path beside Hermannin rantatie instead of the road; 4 lights
rationale.D: Kumpulantaival, then quiet Hermanni streets (Vellamonkatu); little roadside riding; 3 lights; +2 min
rationale.E: Kumpula/Vallila valley paths, then 1.2 km beside Hermannin rantatie; 5 lights
rationale.F: Arabianranta streets and paths, but unsignalised Hämeentie and Väinö Auerin katu crossings
rationale.G: Paths beside Hämeentie/Sturenkatu with unsignalised Hämeentie and Sturenkatu crossings
rationale.H: Same as F, on the path instead of the Berliininkatu streets

notes: D at +2 min saves 2 lights and moves roughly a third of the ride from the busy Hermannin rantatie corridor onto quiet streets.
